title: P6 Activity Release 26 schedule performance and variance typed semantic evidence tranche
reference_version: Oracle Primavera P6 EPPM REST API Release 26
certification_rule: This artifact certifies documented read-side API type and published semantic description only. Writable/default/nullability/import-export certification remains open; no Registry identity is changed by this tranche.

fields.description: Activity schedule percent complete based on where the current data date falls relative to project baseline start and finish; earlier than baseline start gives 0 and later than baseline finish gives 100.
Schedule Performance Index = earned value / planned value.
Schedule Performance Index for labor units = earned value labor units / planned value labor units.

Schedule variance = earned value - planned value. Negative values indicate less work performed than scheduled. Oracle documents this Activity field as a double with this formula but does not declare a currency unit in the Activity schema.
Schedule Variance Index = schedule variance / planned value.
Schedule Variance Index for labor units = schedule variance labor units / planned value labor units.
Schedule variance labor units = earned value labor units - planned value labor units.
Duration between current-project start date and primary baseline start date; calculated as start date - primary baseline start date.
Duration between current-project start date and secondary baseline start date; calculated as start date - secondary baseline start date.
Duration between current-project start date and tertiary baseline start date; calculated as start date - tertiary baseline start date.
